hits.snippet: The capital of Japan is Tokyo. [1][2][3] Throughout history, the national capital of Japan has been in locations other than Tokyo. The oldest capital is Nara.

hits.title: What is the capital of Japan? | Britannica
hits.snippet: The capital of Japan is Tokyo, one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world. It serves as the country's political, economic, and cultural center. Formerly known as Edo, the city became the imperial capital in 1868, replacing Kyōto, and today it is home to major government institutions, businesses, and many of Japan's leading cultural and educational organizations.
